A woman in a green blazer makes a demonstration on how to laminating a document. First, she feeds a paper through a laminator, then explains about the process of de-laminating. She finishes the video by holding up a document in plastic wrap.
The woman is wearing a green suit jacket. She is in front of a pink wall with a power cord behind her. The table she is leaning over is dark brown. The switch box on the wall is white and she is standing near it. The woman has brown hair in a low pony tail and she is holding an electric iron at one point.

summary.brief: A woman demonstrates laminating a sheet and then removes the laminate with a hot iron.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a title slide showing the company name and phone number, then a woman in a green blazer over a purple shirt greets the viewer in front of a pink wall. She feeds a sheet of paper into a large laminator on a dark‑brown table, runs it through, and removes the freshly laminated page while explaining that peeling the plastic by hand can damage the paper. She then picks up an electric iron, heats the laminated surface so the plastic contracts, and carefully peels the laminate away, showing the underlying paper remains intact. She measures the thickness of the original paper and the removed laminate, holds up the de‑laminated document (wrapped in clear plastic), and concludes with contact‑information slides on a yellow‑striped background.

action.detailed: Feed a sheet of paper into the laminator, run it through, then heat the laminated surface with an iron and peel off the plastic laminate, leaving the paper intact, and finally hold up the de‑laminated document.
action.actor: A woman wearing a green blazer over a purple shirt, standing in front of a pink wall

summary.brief: A presenter shows how to remove lamination from documents using a laminator and a hot iron.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a title card that displays the company name and phone number. A young woman wearing a dark green blazer over a purple shirt stands in front of a pink wall and introduces the need for de‑lamination. She first demonstrates the normal laminating process by feeding a sheet of paper into a large laminator, closing the door, and then lifting out the laminated sheet, noting that trying to open it by hand damages the document. A graphic warns "Don't try to open with hands." She then picks up an electric iron, applies heat to the laminated paper, and shows that the plastic film shrinks while the paper remains unchanged, creating creases; a caption reads "Hot iron impact on paper." Next, she runs a laminated document through a de‑lamination machine, pulls the plastic layer away with both hands, and displays the resulting de‑laminated paper as a graphic label reads "De‑laminated documents." Throughout the segment on‑screen graphics reinforce the steps. The segment ends with her holding up the fully de‑laminated document.

action.detailed: Insert the laminated sheet into the de‑lamination machine, run it through, peel off the plastic layer with both hands, then apply a hot iron to the exposed paper and hold up the resulting de‑laminated document.
